findings.title: Validate the rewritten coverage disclosure during reference checks
findings.body: The renderer only replaces the pre-change `oldLimit` text. Once the page has been migrated, that text is absent, so editing or deleting the new disclosure makes this replacement a no-op and `renderSchemaAuthorityReference(...)` returns the tampered page unchanged. Consequently `--check` accepts loss or alteration of the stated coverage boundary, unlike the generated region, status, date, and selector citation. Require exactly one expected current disclosure (or otherwise reject an absent/modified disclosure) before returning the page.

overall_explanation: The reference-integrity check does not protect one of the explicitly owned rewritten disclosures, allowing documentation coverage claims to drift without detection.
